proposal.title: Convert Tandy TRS-80 Model II — CP/M cooperation configuration to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: Tandy TRS-80 Model II — CP/M cooperation configuration
before.description: Tandy-branded Model II configuration with a 4 MHz Z80 and 64 KB installed RAM. It retains Tandy’s native 80-column display, keyboard, eight-inch disk subsystem and existing ports; no Logix video controller, video RAM or monitor is required. The cooperation adds supported CP/M, Abacus and a qualified internal FlexiBUS option. Tandy retains sales and first-line hardware/customer support, with DRI operating-system and AION application escalation.

specification.description: Tandy owns the Model II hardware configuration, branding, sales and customer support.
The cooperation configuration supports the Model II CP/M edition.
Model II-specific FlexiBUS expansion retains the original host architecture.
The Model II Abacus port is a separately defined AION application, not a Tandy-owned software product.
Defines hardware access, software qualification, distribution and support responsibilities.
